introH2: 🌊 What kinds of stays are there around Kung Wiman Beach, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Kung Wiman Beach in Na Yai Am is a stretch of coast on Chanthaburi's eastern side known for its scenic seaside road and viewpoints like Nern Nang Phaya and Hin Krut, and Bangkok folks can drive down for a day trip. Stays here don't all look the same — some are candy-coloured fishing-village-themed resorts that photograph well from every angle, some are small quiet resorts in the low-thousands within walking distance of the beach, some are eco resorts in a forest garden selling organic food and peace and quiet, and some are garden-side villa resorts with private pools that welcome pets. Many people book a seaside stay expecting Andaman-island-clear water and end up feeling it doesn't match what they pictured, because Kung Wiman is an eastern-coast sea where the charm is in the atmosphere and the views more than the colour of the water. This article rounds up 4 stays around Kung Wiman Beach that we've reviewed in depth — each one drawn from reading real guest reviews, telling you both the good points and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites, with direct booking links for all of them.
mrtHtml: The Kung Wiman Beach area in Na Yai Am is easiest to reach by car, because public transport struggles to get right to this spot, and shops and restaurants are spread out along the seaside road (Chaloem Burapha Chonlathit Road / Highway 4036). From Bangkok it's about a 3.5–4 hour drive via the motorway and the eastern highways; from Chanthaburi town it's about 30–45 min. Without a car, take a coach to Chanthaburi town and continue from there — some stays offer pick-up within the nearby area. Things to do around here: Kung Wiman Beach, with quiet sand facing west for a lovely sunset; Hin Krut Viewpoint and Nern Nang Phaya, a popular photo spot along the seaside road; Kung Krabaen Bay, a conservation area with a mangrove boardwalk; and Chao Lao Beach, a short drive along the coast.

entries.name: Peggy's Cove Resort
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.9 · 2,825 reviews · top-rated stay in Na Yai Am
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Beachfront Kung Wiman · about a 3 min walk to the beach
entries.addr: 44 Moo 7, Kung Wiman Beach, Sanam Chai, Na Yai Am
entries.storyHtml: If there's one stay in the Kung Wiman area people photograph the most, many reviews give it to this one — Peggy's Cove Resort is a beachfront resort that takes the fishing-village theme of Peggy's Cove in Nova Scotia, Canada, and sets it down by Kung Wiman Beach in Na Yai Am. What makes it instantly recognisable is the cluster of brightly painted wooden houses — blue, yellow, red, green — lined up along a stream and wooden bridges, with little boats parked as a backdrop, so you can wander and take photos all day as if you were inside a postcard. It's a 38-room property spread across several groups of colourful houses, with the highest score in this set at 8.9 from more than 2,825 real reviews on Agoda — the most in the area. Rooms range from a 35 sqm Superior up to a 60 sqm Grand Deluxe Pool Villa with a private pool, and there's also a Deluxe Jacuzzi Villa with a jacuzzi under a glass roof open to the sky. From the reviews, what guests agree on is that the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, and the breakfast varied — from rice congee with toppings to Western dishes — eaten while taking in the sea view at the Lighthouse Bar & Grill. Staff are friendly too, and there's a golf-cart shuttle from the car park to the rooms, which helps a lot because the grounds are large. The resort is only about a 3 min walk from Kung Wiman Beach, near the Nern Nang Phaya viewpoint. Honest caveats from the reviews: the sea on this side comes out greener and murkier than the Andaman islands, rooms on the seaside-road side catch some traffic noise, some of the multi-storey houses have no lift, the pillows in some rooms are too thick, and some seafood dishes aren't as fresh as expected and are pricey. Best suited to couples, photo lovers, and small families who weigh design and atmosphere over a private beach.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: photograph the colourful houses and the stream in the early morning and just before sunset for the best light and the fewest people. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room on the inner side or a seaside room away from the road, and ask to swap pillows at check-in if you like them soft and thin.

entries.type: Garden Villa Resort · villa with private pool
entries.name: Forest Hill Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Garden side of Kung Wiman · about 1–1.6 km from the beach
entries.addr: Sanam Chai, Na Yai Am (Kung Wiman Beach area · Highway 4036)
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming as a big group or a whole family and want a private house in the middle of nature, Forest Hill Resort is a name worth keeping an eye on in the Kung Wiman area — a small garden-side villa resort in Sanam Chai, Na Yai Am, where several houses are spread across grounds surrounded by greenery, giving a quiet, private feel. What makes many people pick it is that some villas have a private pool, from a 3-bedroom for 6 up to a house for 8 with 4 queen beds, ideal for groups of friends or large families who want to rent the whole house and stay together — at a more accessible price than the pool villas in Hua Hin or Khao Yai. Another thing you don't often find at a seaside resort is its pet policy: you can bring dogs and cats to stay (for an extra fee). From the reviews, the score sits in good territory at around 9.0 from 48 reviews, with guests consistently praising the quiet natural setting, clean rooms and houses, the good-quality included breakfast for the price, the large free car park, and friendly staff who help suggest places to visit nearby. The resort is about 1–1.6 km from Kung Wiman Beach, a few minutes' drive, near the Hin Kung Wiman viewpoint and Wat Khao Sukim. Honest caveats from the reviews: the resort isn't on the beach, so you have to drive out to the sea; it's a small stay with no fitness room or spa like a big hotel; the review count isn't large yet so the score may swing; and you pretty much need a car in this area. Best suited to families, groups of friends, couples who want privacy, and people travelling with pets.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you're coming specifically for a villa with a private pool, specify the room type clearly when booking, because each house is different and they're limited. If you're bringing a pet, let the resort know and ask about the fee in advance, and confirm availability directly with the resort before you travel.

entries.name: Faasai Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: TripAdvisor 4.3/5 · #4 of 28 hotels in Chanthaburi · 106 reviews
entries.badge: 🌿 Eco resort in a forest garden · Thai-massage spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Foot of the Kung Wiman hill · about a 10 min walk to the beach
entries.addr: Kung Wiman Beach, Sanam Chai, Na Yai Am
entries.storyHtml: Faasai Resort & Spa is a stay you can sum up in one line: "an eco resort in a forest garden that does the environmental work for real, not just slapping a label on it." Its origin is genuinely interesting — Bronwen, a New Zealander, and her Thai husband Surin bought an empty plot near Kung Wiman Beach and gradually planted trees, made a herb garden, and built the bungalows one by one with their own hands. The resort is a small property of around 15 houses spread across the garden, ranging from simple bungalows to villas, a penthouse, and a two-bedroom house, set on a hillside at the back known as Springwater Hill within the Kung Krabaen Bay conservation area. The three things guests talk about most: the shady forest-garden setting, with a koi pond, fountains, and wooden walkways through a garden laid out by feng shui; the organic food, with the kitchen cooking fresh from the resort's own vegetables, fruit, and herbs, homemade in flavour with vegetarian options; and the Thai-massage spa, praised for being relaxing. About a 10 min walk from the resort (around 640 m) brings you to Kung Wiman Beach, which faces west for a lovely sunset and is still a local beach with almost no one on it. TripAdvisor gives it 4.3 out of 5, ranking it #4 of 28 hotels in Chanthaburi, and it won Best Small Hotel at the TAT Green Awards 2009. Service is its strongest point — many say it feels more like staying at a friend's house than checking into a hotel. Honest caveats from the reviews: the location is about 30 km from town so you pretty much need a car; the entrance near the road catches some traffic noise; many dishes have to be ordered ahead because the kitchen cooks fresh; some houses are old for their age and a few people feel they don't match the website photos; some staff speak limited English; and being in the middle of a garden, there are bugs as you'd expect. Best suited to couples, families, and nature-minded travellers who want a quiet stay, good food, and don't mind a lack of luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you're having dinner at the resort, order ahead with the kitchen because it's cooked fresh and many dishes need preparation time. If a fresh room matters to you, ask for updated photos and choose a recently renovated house before booking. Come in the cool season (Nov–Feb) for cool weather and a calm sea, and bring mosquito repellent because you're in the middle of a garden.

entries.storyHtml: Where other stays in this area sell design or private villas, Vanavaree Resort chooses to sell the most straightforward thing — a small, quiet, accessibly priced stay just a few steps from the sea. It's a small resort of around 15 rooms in the Kung Wiman Beach area of Sanam Chai, Na Yai Am, a two-storey white-render building in a minimalist style, with every room having a balcony to sit and catch the sea breeze and listen to the waves in a quiet setting. Rooms range from a Standard King for couples up to a Family Room set up with beds for a family or group of friends. Its biggest draw is the location — a few minutes' walk to Kung Wiman Beach, only about 200 m from the Hin Krut viewpoint, about 750 m from the Kung Wiman viewpoint, and Nern Nang Phaya within about 2–3 km, so you can wake up early to stroll along the sea or catch the morning light with ease. There's a small outdoor pool in the garden, a barbecue corner to grill your own seafood, and the Vanavaree restaurant serving Thai food and seafood. From the reviews, the overall score sits around 7.7 from a modest number of guests, with location scoring high at around 9.2 and service around 8.2, and many praising the friendly owner and staff who help recommend places to visit and eat. Prices start around ฿1,300/night in normal periods, the best value in this set for a stay near the sea with a pool. Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a building that's been open since around 2016, so some rooms and furniture are starting to show their age; the air-con in some rooms doesn't get fully cold on very hot days, so the cleanliness and amenities scores come in below location and service; and you pretty much need a car in this area. Best suited to couples, small families, and groups of friends who want to come to Kung Wiman Beach for a quiet, budget-friendly getaway.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: it's a small stay that's been open for years, so ask for the latest room photos or specify a recently renovated room before booking, to avoid an old room or air-con that doesn't get fully cold. Check whether breakfast is included in the price, because packages differ by booking channel. With only around 15 rooms it fills up fast over long weekends, so book ahead.
pros: Good location, walk to Kung Wiman Beach, about 200 m from the Hin Krut viewpoint (location score around 9.2)
Quiet, private setting, with a small pool and a barbecue corner

faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers often ask about Kung Wiman Beach stays, Chanthaburi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best Kung Wiman Beach stay?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style. If you're focused on photos and atmosphere, Peggy's Cove Resort scores 8.9 with the most reviews — more than 2,825 — and colourful fishing-village-themed houses. If you're coming as a group and want a villa with a private pool, Forest Hill Resort. If you're nature-minded and love peace and quiet and good food, Faasai Resort & Spa, an eco resort in a forest garden. And if you're on a budget and want to stay near the sea, Vanavaree Resort starts in the low thousands, the best value in this set.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Kung Wiman Beach stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿1,200–2,500 per night. The more accessible end is Faasai from ฿1,200, Vanavaree from ฿1,300, and Forest Hill from ฿1,500. Peggy's Cove starts at ฿2,500, and villas with private pools run up to around ฿6,000–6,500 at all of them. All prices are approximate starting prices for standard rooms; during long weekends and the fruit season prices may be higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Is Kung Wiman Beach nice · is the water clear?
faq.a: Kung Wiman Beach is an eastern-coast sea, where the water comes out greener and murkier than the Andaman side — not island-clear. But it's an area known for its scenic seaside road and viewpoints, especially Nern Nang Phaya and the Hin Krut viewpoint, and the beach faces west for a lovely sunset. It suits coming to relax, take photos, and stroll along the sea near Bangkok more than coming to swim in clear water.

faq.q: ❓ Without a car, is it convenient to stay around Kung Wiman Beach?
faq.a: The Kung Wiman Beach area in Na Yai Am is awkward to reach by public transport, with shops and restaurants spread out along the seaside road, so it suits having a car best. Without a car, take a coach to Chanthaburi town and continue from there — some stays offer pick-up within the nearby area (such as Vanavaree, Faasai), but you should let them know and plan your travel and supplies in advance.

faq.q: ❓ Which Kung Wiman Beach stays are pet-friendly · which have a villa with a private pool?
faq.a: Forest Hill Resort welcomes pets (for an extra fee), which you don't often find at a seaside resort, and has villas with a private pool from a 3-bedroom for 6 up to a house for 8. A villa with a private pool is also available at Peggy's Cove (Grand Deluxe Pool Villa) — we recommend letting the resort know and asking about the conditions in advance before you travel.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a Kung Wiman Beach stay?
faq.a: Most stays here are small (15–48 rooms/houses), so they fill up fast. During long weekends, Saturday–Sunday, and Chanthaburi's fruit season (late rainy / early cool season), book 1–2 months ahead, especially if you're coming specifically for a villa with a private pool, which is limited. Every platform usually offers Free Cancellation — we recommend locking in a rate like that first if your plans aren't firm, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
